featured_reviews.name: Riddhi Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Truly Unforgettable School Trip Experience with Joshi Travels! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

We recently went on a school trip to Manali and Chandigarh with our enthusiastic students from Grades 8 and 10, and I must say — it was one of the best trips ever, all thanks to the exceptional planning and execution by Joshi Travels.

From the very beginning till the end, the trip was handled with such care and dedication. Our tour guides, Dhairya Sir and Viraj Sir, were absolutely outstanding. They went above and beyond to ensure that every child felt safe, seen, and valued. Whether it was managing early wake-up calls, coordinating activities, arranging meals and snacks, or simply making sure every student was tucked in on time — they handled everything seamlessly and with a smile.

What truly stood out was their personal connection with the students — knowing each child by name, patiently attending to their needs, and creating beautiful memories with them. One of the most magical moments was when the students wished to have lunch amidst the snow — and to our surprise, our lunch was delivered via a zip line! It was moments like these that made this trip truly unforgettable.

The accommodation and food at every stop were top-notch, exceeding expectations in both comfort and taste. Every little detail was taken care of, and not once did we feel unorganized or rushed.

Kudos to Dhairya Sir and Viraj Sir for their incredible energy, warmth, and professionalism. Their ability to balance fun with responsibility made all the difference.

I highly recommend Joshi Travels for any school or group tour. Their dedication, planning, and passion for delivering quality experiences are truly commendable. We returned not just with memories, but with hearts full of gratitude.
